authority: Compilation creates no training permission, protected data access, HOLDOUT release, model evaluation, promotion or runtime execution.
deterministic_rebuild: Same immutable source snapshot plus pinned parser/config/transform/seed/order produces byte-identical content and source-set digest; read-only rebuild checks existing version by ID/digest. New snapshot or interpretation requires fresh DATASET_VERSION_ID and examples. Never silently regenerate an existing ID.
example_bindings: four source artifact role IDs and byte digests
labels: Use only frozen OP1_DATASET_COMPILATION_POLICY.json label enum; each label has independent immutable support and exact union of label_evidence_ids.
pipeline: Select sealed immutable source graph and exact source snapshot/manifest/graph-root/closure artifacts.
Verify each typed ID and byte hash through registry; recompute full transitive source closure.
Apply independent license, access, supervised eligibility and training-use checks; UNKNOWN blocks requested training-use dataset.
Pin parser SHA-256, normalization config SHA-256, transformation ID/code/config/seed/order and interpretation schema.
Derive examples and labels with per-label evidence/decision basis; reject ambiguous or contradictory support.
Group causally connected RUNs/repairs and shared evidence in one split; enforce protected HOLDOUT boundary.
Reject duplicate semantic key and mutable source alias; create-new immutable dataset version and example records.
redaction_boundary: Public release is a separate derived dataset version with pinned deterministic redaction transformation and review decision. Private raw evidence stays private; emit only permitted derived fields and hash-bound source IDs as allowed by disclosure policy. Restricted/UNKNOWN access blocks export. Redaction cannot remove internal provenance closure.
reject: UNKNOWN/restricted permission for requested training use
source_of_truth: Qualified append-only evidence graph and raw bytes, never mutable latest/index views.

source_set_canonicalization.encoding: UTF-8 type TAB ID TAB lowercase-sha256 LF for each tuple; final LF; no BOM; empty set and duplicates invalid
source_set_canonicalization.exclude: Output DATASET_VERSION_ID, DATASET_EXAMPLE_ID and compilation TRANSFORMATION_ID; bind each separately
source_set_canonicalization.include: Transitive closure of source_*_ids and four mandatory prior committed artifact roles: source snapshot, manifest, graph root commitment, closure certificate
source_set_canonicalization.sort: ASCII-restricted fields in Unicode code point order on type, ID, SHA-256
source_set_canonicalization.tuple: (entity_type, entity_id, committed_record_sha256) per distinct immutable registry entity in complete source closure
